items.title_cn: 整合临床与脂质组学特征的可解释机器学习框架用于高甘油三酯血症胰腺炎早期严重程度分层
items.title_en: An explainable machine learning framework integrating clinical and lipidomic signatures for early severity stratification of hypertriglyceridemic pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 背景 高甘油三酯血症性胰腺炎（HTGP）日益被认为是急性胰腺炎的主要病因之一，与其他病因相比，其早期重症进展、全身并发症及死亡风险更高。然而，目前可用的评分系统在HTGP中表现出准确性有限且机制可解释性较差的问题。目的 开发并验证一种可解释的机器学习模型，用于HTGP早期重症进展分层，并探索其潜在的脂质组学机制。方法 纳入2020年至2025年间收治的288例HTGP患者的回顾性队列。患者被分为轻症急性胰腺炎（MAP）和中重症/重症急性胰腺炎（MSAP/SAP）。采用整合八种算法的集成特征选择方法识别稳健的预测因子。构建并比较十种机器学习模型。使用SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）分析解释模型输出。在15对匹配的重症/非重症AP患者中进行非靶向血清脂质组学分析，并结合KEGG通路富集分析，以探索所识别预测因子的生物学相关性。结果 在288例患者中，150例（52.1%）在入院时被分类为MSAP/SAP。共识别出十个与炎症激活、凝血功能障碍、内皮渗漏及全身损伤相关的预测因子，包括IL-6、D-二聚体、PCT、白蛋白、CRP、SIRS、胸腔积液及胰腺炎相关腹水。在所有候选算法中，朴素贝叶斯模型实现了最佳的整体区分能力（AUC = 0.841），优于APACHE II和改良Marshall评分。校准评估显示校准截距为−0.0332，Brier评分为0.2035；校准斜率为0.2009，表明预测概率存在压缩，提示在绝对风险估计中需谨慎。决策曲线分析显示，在0至约0.85的阈值概率范围内具有正向临床净获益，且朴素贝叶斯模型在临床相关阈值范围内均优于两种基准评分系统。SHAP分析确定IL-6、D-二聚体和PCT为最具影响力的预测因子。在15对匹配亚队列中的探索性脂质组学通路富集分析发现，甘油磷脂代谢、鞘脂代谢、坏死性凋亡及自噬通路发生改变，为所识别的临床预测因子提供了产生假说的生物学背景。结论 我们开发了一个整合临床及探索性脂质组学证据的可解释机器学习框架，用于HTGP入院时的早期严重程度分层。所识别的预测因子汇聚于涉及炎症、凝血及内皮功能障碍的相互关联的生物学轴线上。脂质组学子研究提供了补充的通路层面背景，支持这些预测因子的生物学合理性。由于本研究基于单中心回顾性队列且未进行外部验证，研究结果应视为初步结论；在临床部署前需进行前瞻性多中心验证。
items.abstract_en: Background Hypertriglyceridemic pancreatitis (HTGP) is increasingly recognized as a major etiology of acute pancreatitis and is associated with a higher risk of early severe progression, systemic complications, and mortality compared with other etiologies. However, currently available scoring systems demonstrate limited accuracy and poor mechanistic interpretability in HTGP. Aim To develop and validate an explainable machine learning model for early stratification of severe progression in HTGP and to explore its underlying lipidomic mechanisms. Methods A retrospective cohort of 288 patients with HTGP admitted between 2020 and 2025 was included. Patients were categorized into mild acute pancreatitis (MAP) and moderately severe/severe acute pancreatitis (MSAP/SAP). Ensemble feature selection integrating eight algorithms was applied to identify robust predictors. Ten machine learning models were constructed and compared. SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) analysis was used to interpret model outputs. Untargeted serum lipidomics combined with KEGG pathway enrichment analysis was performed in 15 matched severe/non-severe AP pairs to explore the biological relevance of identified predictors. Results Among 288 patients, 150 (52.1%) were classified as MSAP/SAP at hospital admission. Ten predictors associated with inflammatory activation, coagulation dysfunction, endothelial leakage, and systemic injury were identified, including IL-6, D-dimer, PCT, albumin, CRP, SIRS, pleural effusion, and pancreatitis-associated ascitic fluid. Among all candidate algorithms, the Naive Bayes model achieved the best overall discrimination (AUC = 0.841), outperforming APACHE II and modified Marshall scores. Calibration assessment revealed a calibration intercept of −0.0332 and a Brier score of 0.2035; the calibration slope of 0.2009 indicated compression of predicted probabilities, suggesting caution in absolute risk estimation. Decision curve analysis demonstrated positive net clinical benefit across threshold probabilities from 0 to approximately 0.85, with the Naive Bayes model outperforming both benchmark scoring systems across clinically relevant thresholds. SHAP analysis identified IL-6, D-dimer, and PCT as the most influential predictors. Exploratory lipidomic pathway enrichment in a sub-cohort of 15 matched pairs identified alterations in glycerophospholipid metabolism, sphingolipid metabolism, necroptosis, and autophagy pathways, providing hypothesis-generating biological context for the identified clinical predictors. Conclusion We developed an explainable machine learning framework integrating clinical and exploratory lipidomic evidence for early severity stratification of HTGP at hospital admission. The identified predictors converged on interconnected biological axes involving inflammation, coagulation, and endothelial dysfunction. The lipidomic sub-study provided complementary pathway-level context supporting the biological plausibility of these predictors. As this study is based on a single-center retrospective cohort without external validation, findings should be regarded as preliminary; prospective multicenter validation is required before clinical deployment.
items.summary_cn: 该研究开发并验证了一个可解释的机器学习框架，用于高甘油三酯血症性胰腺炎（HTGP）的早期严重程度分层，其中朴素贝叶斯模型表现最佳（AUC=0.841），优于APACHE II和改良Marshall评分，并识别出IL-6、D-二聚体和PCT等关键预测因子；脂质组学亚研究提示甘油磷脂代谢、鞘脂代谢、坏死性凋亡和自噬通路改变。

items.title_cn: 中性粒细胞-淋巴细胞比值对急性胰腺炎患者不良预后的临床意义
items.title_en: Clinical Significance of the Neutrophil-Lymphocyte Ratio as a Prognostic Marker for Adverse Outcomes in Patients with Acute Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 目的：评估中性粒细胞–淋巴细胞比值（NLR）在急性胰腺炎患者中的预后价值，并确定其在预测疾病严重程度和不良结局方面的实用性。材料与方法：一项前瞻性横断面研究，纳入50例确诊为急性胰腺炎的患者。分别在第0天、第1天和第2天计算NLR，并按CT严重程度分组进行比较。采用方差分析和卡方检验进行统计分析。结果：轻度和中度病例中NLR下降，而重度病例中NLR显著升高。各组间差异具有高度统计学显著性（P < 0.01）。较高的NLR与更长的住院时间和器官功能障碍相关。结论：NLR是一种简单、经济且可靠的标志物，可用于急性胰腺炎严重程度的早期评估和预后判断。
items.abstract_en: Objectives: To evaluate the prognostic value of the neutrophil–lymphocyte ratio (NLR) in patients with acute pancreatitis and to determine its usefulness in predicting disease severity and adverse outcomes. Material and Methods: A prospective cross-sectional study including 50 patients diagnosed with acute pancreatitis. NLR was calculated on day 0, day 1, and day 2 and compared across CT severity groups. Statistical analysis was performed using ANOVA and chi-square tests. Results: NLR declined in mild and moderate cases but increased significantly in severe cases. The difference among groups was statistically highly significant (P < 0.01). Higher NLR was associated with longer hospital stay and organ dysfunction. Conclusion: NLR is a simple, cost-effective and reliable marker for early assessment of severity and prognosis in acute pancreatitis.
items.summary_cn: NLR在重症急性胰腺炎中显著升高，与住院时间延长和器官功能障碍相关，可作为早期评估严重程度和预后的简单、经济、可靠的标志物。

items.title_cn: 血浆置换治疗高甘油三酯血症急性胰腺炎的疗效与风险：系统综述与荟萃分析的补充材料
items.title_en: Supplemental Material for: Therapeutic Outcomes and Risks of Plasmapheresis in Hypertriglyceridemia Acute Pancreatitis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.abstract_cn: 引言：高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）的发病率持续上升，且重症比例较高。血浆置换作为HTG-AP治疗干预手段的获益仍存在争议。因此，我们进行了一项荟萃分析，检索现有证据以评估其有效性与安全性。方法：在主要电子数据库中进行了全面的文献检索，依据预设标准筛选符合条件的研究。纳入的研究比较了血浆置换联合标准药物治疗（血浆置换组，PE组）与单纯标准药物治疗（对照组）在HTG-AP患者中的疗效。研究结局包括24小时血清甘油三酯（TG）降低率、院内死亡率、局部/全身并发症发生率、住院时间（LOS）、住院费用及复发率。结果：共检索到986篇文章，纳入20项研究，涉及1，576例患者（PE组：n=636；对照组：n=940）。分析显示，PE组与对照组在死亡率（RR 1.43，95%CI 0.91-2.26，P=0.12）、全身并发症发生率（RR：0.96；95%CI：0.61-1.50；P=0.86）、局部并发症发生率（RR 1.01，95% CI 0.84-1.21；P=0.91）及需要侵入性操作的比例（RR 0.86，95% CI 0.48-1.54，P=0.62）方面均无统计学显著差异。与对照组相比，PE组在24小时（SMD 10.13，95% CI 3.39-16.87，P<0.01）和48小时（SMD 8.14，95%CI 4.30-11.98，P<0.0001）的TG降低幅度均更高。PE组住院时间延长（WMD 2.40，95%CI 0.14-4.66，P=0.04），同时费用显著增加（WMD 27.56，95%CI 16.61-38.51，P<0.00001）。亚组分析显示，在非重症病例中血浆置换增加了死亡率。结论：尽管血浆置换能显著降低血清TG水平，但对HTG-AP的关键临床结局并无显著获益。因此，现有临床证据不支持将其作为HTG-AP的常规治疗手段。应开展大规模随机对照试验以进一步评估其疗效、最佳适应证及治疗时机。关键词：血浆置换；血浆交换；双重滤过血浆置换；高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎；荟萃分析。
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Hypertriglyceridemia acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) is constantly increasing and has a higher proportion of severe cases. The benefit of plasmapheresis as a therapeutic intervention for HTG-AP remains controversial. Thus we conducted a meta-analysis to search existing evidence to evaluate its efficacy and safety. Methods: A comprehensive literature search was performed in key electronic databases to search eligible studies based on predetermined criteria. Included studies compared plasmapheresis combined with standard medical therapy (Plasmapheresis group, PE group) versus standard medical therapy alone (Control group) in HTG-AP patients. Study outcomes were 24-hour serum triglyceride (TG) reduction rate, in-hospital mortality, incidence of local/systemic complications, hospital length of stay (LOS), hospitalization costs, and recurrence rate. Results: A total of 986 articles were retrieved and 20 studies involving 1,576 patients (PE group: n=636; Control group: n=940) were included. Analysis revealed that no statistically significant difference was found in mortality (RR 1.43, 95%CI 0.91-2.26, P=0.12), incidence of systemic complications (RR: 0.96; 95%CI: 0.61-1.50; P = 0.86), incidence of local complications (RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.84-1.21; P=0.91) , requirement for invasive procedures (RR 0.86, 95% CI 0.48-1.54, P=0.62) between PE group and Control group. PE group has higher TG reduction at both 24h (SMD 10.13, 95% CI 3.39-16.87, P<0.01) and 48h (SMD 8.14, 95%CI 4.30-11.98, P<0.0001) compared with control group. PE group exhibited a prolonged LOS (WMD 2.40, 95%CI 0.14-4.66, P=0.04) alongside substantially increased costs (WMD 27.56, 95%CI 16.61-38.51, P<0.00001). Subgroup analysis indicated plasmapheresis increased mortality in non-severe cases. Conclusion: While plasmapheresis significantly reduces serum TG levels, it confers no significant benefit on critical clinical outcomes in HTG-AP. Thus existing clinical evidence does not support its use as a routine treatment for HTG-AP. Large-scale RCTs should be carried out to further evaluate its efficacy, optimal indications, and timing. Key words: plasmapheresis; plasma exchange; double filtration plasmapheresis; hypertriglyceridemic acute pancreatitis; meta-analysis.
items.summary_cn: 血浆置换可显著降低高甘油三酯血症急性胰腺炎患者的血清甘油三酯水平，但对死亡率、局部/全身并发症等关键临床结局无显著改善，且延长住院时间并增加费用，现有证据不支持其作为常规治疗。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎严重程度评估中的全球免疫-营养-炎症指数（GINI）：一项比较研究
items.title_en: The Global Immune-Nutrition-Inflammation Index (GINI) in Acute Pancreatitis Severity Assessment: A Comparative Study
items.summary_cn: 该研究提出并比较了全球免疫-营养-炎症指数（GINI）在急性胰腺炎严重程度评估中的价值，但摘要未提供具体结果或结论。

items.title_cn: 超声内镜引导的剪切波弹性成像：现有证据与二维剪切波弹性成像的新兴作用
items.title_en: EUS-Guided Shear-Wave-Based Elastography: Current Evidence and the Emerging Role of Two-Dimensional Shear-Wave Elastography
items.abstract_cn: 弹性成像是一种基于超声的技术，能够无创评估组织硬度。在超声内镜（EUS）中，弹性成像最初以应变法形式引入，提供关于组织形变的定性或半定量信息。近年来的技术发展使得基于剪切波的弹性成像能够整合到EUS平台中，包括剪切波测量（SWM）、点剪切波弹性成像（pSWE）和二维剪切波弹性成像（2D-SWE）。与应变弹性成像不同，剪切波技术通过测量剪切波速度或推导出的弹性模量，提供组织硬度的定量评估。本篇特邀叙述性综述总结了EUS引导下基于剪切波的弹性成像在胰腺和肝胆疾病中的技术原理、术语、质量控制要求及当前临床证据。由于现有EUS文献中大部分来源于EUS-SWM或点式SWE，而非真正的二维剪切波弹性成像（2D-SWE），采集模式是解读临床证据和评估临床成熟度的核心决定因素。现有数据表明，EUS引导下基于剪切波的弹性成像在技术上可行且具有生物学合理性，但其临床成熟度仍因适应证而异。证据最为令人鼓舞的领域包括慢性胰腺炎、早期慢性胰腺炎、自身免疫性胰腺炎活动度监测，以及部分肝脏病学内镜应用场景，尤其是经腹超声技术可能效果不佳患者的肝纤维化评估。相比之下，现有证据不支持将EUS引导下基于剪切波的弹性成像作为鉴别实性胰腺病变（包括胰腺导管腺癌）的独立诊断工具，因为恶性病变、炎性肿块和背景胰腺实质之间的绝对硬度值往往存在重叠。在常规临床实施之前，需要标准化的采集方案、疾病特异性截断值、多中心可重复性数据，以及超越既有诊断路径的增量临床价值证据。
items.abstract_en: Elastography is an ultrasound-based technique that enables the non-invasive assessment of tissue stiffness. In endoscopic ultrasound (EUS), elastography was initially introduced as a strain-based method, providing qualitative or semi-quantitative information on tissue deformation. More recent technological developments have enabled the integration of shear-wave-based elastography into EUS platforms, including shear-wave measurement (SWM), point shear-wave elastography (pSWE), and two-dimensional shear-wave elastography (2D-SWE). Unlike strain elastography, shear-wave techniques provide quantitative estimates of tissue stiffness by measuring shear-wave velocity or a derived elastic modulus. This invited narrative review summarizes the technical principles, terminology, quality-control requirements, and current clinical evidence for EUS-guided shear-wave-based elastography in pancreatic and hepatobiliary diseases. Because much of the available EUS literature derives from EUS-SWM or point SWE rather than true 2D-SWE, acquisition mode is a central determinant when interpreting clinical evidence and clinical readiness. Current data suggest that EUS-guided shear-wave-based elastography is technically feasible and biologically plausible, but its clinical maturity remains indication-specific. Evidence is most encouraging in chronic pancreatitis, early chronic pancreatitis, autoimmune pancreatitis activity monitoring, and selected endo-hepatology settings, particularly liver fibrosis assessment in patients in whom transabdominal techniques may be suboptimal. In contrast, available evidence does not support EUS-guided shear-wave-based elastography as a standalone diagnostic test for differentiating solid pancreatic lesions, including pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, because absolute stiffness values often overlap among malignant lesions, inflammatory masses, and background parenchyma. Before routine clinical implementation, standardized acquisition protocols, disease-specific cut-offs, multicenter reproducibility data, and evidence of incremental clinical value beyond established diagnostic pathways are required.
items.summary_cn: EUS引导的剪切波弹性成像在慢性胰腺炎、早期慢性胰腺炎、自身免疫性胰腺炎活动监测及特定肝脏纤维化评估中证据最有前景，但尚不支持作为区分实性胰腺病变（包括胰腺导管腺癌）的独立诊断测试。

items.title_cn: 急性坏死性胰腺炎表现为广泛单侧下肢肌炎、筋膜炎及无菌性反应性膝关节滑膜炎：一种罕见的胰外表现
items.title_en: Acute Necrotizing Pancreatitis Presenting With Extensive Unilateral Lower Limb Myositis, Fasciitis, and Sterile Reactive Knee Synovitis: A Rare Extra-pancreatic Manifestation
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎的肌肉骨骼表现并不常见，最常被描述为胰腺脂膜炎或胰腺脂膜炎-多关节炎（PPP）综合征。伴有筋膜受累的弥漫性炎症性肌炎极为罕见，可能类似蜂窝织炎、化脓性肌炎、感染性关节炎、坏死性筋膜炎或深静脉血栓形成，导致诊断不确定并可能引发不必要的手术干预。一名44岁男性患者表现为持续15天的剧烈上腹痛并向背部放射，随后出现发热及左大腿、膝部和小腿快速进展的疼痛性肿胀。血清脂肪酶升高（867 U/L）。增强计算机断层扫描（CECT）显示急性坏死性胰腺炎，胰腺坏死<30%，多发急性坏死性积液，改良CT严重程度指数（MCTSI）为8/10，并伴有脾静脉、肠系膜上静脉及门静脉部分血栓形成。静脉多普勒排除深静脉血栓形成。大腿及膝部磁共振成像（MRI）显示弥漫性多间室炎症性肌炎、广泛筋膜积液蔓延、弥漫性皮下脂膜炎及轻度膝关节积液，无骨髓炎或可引流脓肿。膝关节超声显示股四头肌水肿伴轻度髌上囊积液。滑液分析显示白细胞计数仅为250个/mm³，血液及尿液培养均为无菌生长。基于临床影像学表现及感染排除，诊断为胰腺酶介导的下肢肌炎、筋膜炎、脂膜炎及无菌性反应性滑膜炎。患者接受保守治疗，包括急性胰腺炎的支持治疗、内脏静脉血栓形成的治疗性抗凝、镇痛、营养支持及物理治疗，临床逐渐康复，无需手术干预。本病例通过展示经MRI证实的广泛肌炎、筋膜炎、脂膜炎及无菌性滑膜炎与坏死性胰腺炎及内脏静脉血栓形成同时发生，扩展了急性胰腺炎公认的肌肉骨骼表现谱。识别这一罕见病种至关重要，因其与软组织感染高度相似，但对针对潜在胰腺疾病的治疗有反应。多模态影像学检查及仔细排除感染性病因对于确立诊断和避免不必要的手术治疗至关重要。
items.abstract_en: Musculoskeletal manifestations of acute pancreatitis are uncommon and are most frequently described as pancreatic panniculitis or pancreatic panniculitis-polyarthritis (PPP) syndrome. Diffuse inflammatory myositis with fascial involvement is exceedingly rare and may mimic cellulitis, pyomyositis, septic arthritis, necrotizing fasciitis, or deep venous thrombosis, leading to diagnostic uncertainty and potentially unnecessary surgical intervention. A 44-year-old man presented with severe epigastric pain radiating to the back for 15 days, followed by fever and rapidly progressive painful swelling of the left thigh, knee, and leg. Serum lipase was elevated (867 U/L). Contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CECT) demonstrated acute necrotizing pancreatitis with <30% pancreatic necrosis, multiple acute necrotic collections, a modified CT severity index (MCTSI) of 8/10, and partial thrombosis of the splenic, superior mesenteric, and portal veins. Venous Doppler excluded deep venous thrombosis. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the thigh and knee revealed diffuse multicompartment inflammatory myositis, extensive fascial fluid tracking, diffuse subcutaneous panniculitis, and mild knee joint effusion without osteomyelitis or drainable abscess. Knee ultrasonography showed quadriceps edema with mild suprapatellar effusion. Synovial fluid analysis demonstrated a leukocyte count of only 250 cells/mm³, while blood and urine cultures remained sterile. Based on the clinicoradiological findings and exclusion of infection, a diagnosis of pancreatic enzyme-mediated lower limb myositis, fasciitis, panniculitis, and sterile reactive synovitis was made. The patient was treated conservatively with supportive care for acute pancreatitis, therapeutic anticoagulation for splanchnic venous thrombosis, analgesia, nutritional support, and physiotherapy, resulting in progressive clinical recovery without surgical intervention. This case expands the recognized musculoskeletal spectrum of acute pancreatitis by demonstrating extensive MRI-confirmed myositis, fasciitis, panniculitis, and sterile synovitis occurring concurrently with necrotizing pancreatitis and splanchnic venous thrombosis. Recognition of this rare entity is essential because it closely mimics soft tissue infection but responds to treatment directed at the underlying pancreatic disease. Multimodality imaging and careful exclusion of infective etiologies are critical to establishing the diagnosis and avoiding unnecessary operative management.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了急性坏死性胰腺炎罕见合并广泛单侧下肢肌炎、筋膜炎及无菌性反应性膝关节炎，通过多模态影像排除感染并保守治疗成功，扩展了胰腺炎胰腺外表现的疾病谱，对消化内科医生在鉴别胰腺炎相关软组织并发症时有参考价值。

items.title_cn: 胆囊十二指肠瘘致胆结石性输入袢梗阻后迟发性十二指肠穿孔1例
items.title_en: Delayed duodenal perforation following gallstone-induced afferent loop obstruction due to a cholecystoduodenal fistula: a case report
items.abstract_cn: <title>摘要</title> 背景：由胆囊十二指肠瘘引起的胆石性肠梗阻是慢性胆石症的罕见并发症，常导致小肠梗阻。虽然回肠梗阻较为常见，但十二指肠嵌顿及其后果（包括输入袢综合征）的报道仍不足。在这些病例中，一个显著但常被忽视的风险是胆石取出后延迟性十二指肠穿孔。方法：我们报告一例77岁女性患者，在远端胃切除加Billroth II式重建40年后，因胆石经胆囊十二指肠瘘迁移而继发输入袢综合征。胆石嵌顿于十二指肠第三段，导致输入袢梗阻、胆汁淤积和急性胰腺炎。行急诊剖腹探查及胆石取出术以恢复输入袢通畅。结果：然而，术后两天，患者在既往嵌顿部位出现十二指肠穿孔，需二次手术修复。结论：本病例强调，由于存在延迟性穿孔的风险，胆石引起的十二指肠梗阻患者需密切的术后监测，并提示识别胆囊十二指肠瘘作为输入袢综合征潜在病因的重要性。新颖之处：本病例强调胆石诱发的输入袢综合征后可能发生延迟性穿孔，并建议对此类患者加强术后监护。
items.abstract_en: <title>Abstract</title> Background: Gallstone ileus due to a cholecystoduodenal fistula is a rare complication of chronic cholelithiasis, often leading to small bowel obstruction. While ileal obstruction is common, duodenal impaction and its consequences, including afferent loop syndrome, remain underreported. A significant yet often overlooked risk in these cases is delayed duodenal perforation after gallstone removal. Method: We present a 77-year-old female who developed afferent loop syndrome secondary to a gallstone migrating through a cholecystoduodenal fistula 40 years after distal gastrectomy with Billroth II reconstruction. The gallstone lodged in the third portion of the duodenum, causing afferent loop obstruction, bile stasis, and acute pancreatitis. Emergency laparotomy and gallstone removal were performed to restore the afferent loop flow. Result: However, after two days postoperatively, the patient developed duodenal perforation at the previous site of impaction, requiring a second surgery for repair. Conclusion: This case underscores the need for close postoperative monitoring in gallstone-induced duodenal obstructions due to the risk of delayed perforation and highlights the importance of recognizing cholecystoduodenal fistula as an underlying cause of afferent loop syndrome. Novel Aspect: This case emphasizes the possibility of delayed perforation after a gallstone-induced afferent loop syndrome and recommends intense postoperative care for these patients.
items.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了一例因胆囊十二指肠瘘导致的胆结石引发输入袢梗阻，并在取石术后两天发生延迟性十二指肠穿孔的罕见病例，强调了术后密切监测的重要性。该病例涉及急性胰腺炎和十二指肠并发症，与用户关注的胰腺炎及内镜/外科并发症管理有一定关联，但属于罕见病例报告，非核心文献。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
